sloka: ऐश्वर्ये वा सुविस्तीर्णे व्यसने वा सुदारुणे ।रज्ज्वेव पुरुषं बद्ध्वा कृतान्तः परिकर्षति ।। ५.३७.३।।।।
transliteration: aiśvarye vā suvistīrṇe vyasane vā sudāruṇe ।rajjveva puruṣaṁ baddhvā kṛtāntaḥ parikarṣati ।। 5.37.3।।।।

translations.english: "Death snatches a man tied with a cord, whether he is rolling in luxury or sinking in adversity.
